create_flickr30k_dataset: create a Flickr30K dataset instance from lmms-lab/flickr30k with a specified split and processor
register_flickr_dataset: register the Flickr30K class as a 'flickr' or 'flickr30k' dataset type with TextGenerationDataset
apply_flickr_chat_template: apply a default <|user|>/<|assistant|> chat template to a tokenizer missing one
transform_flickr_sample: transform a Flickr30K sample into a text-and-images dict with an image caption question
load_flickr_split: load a train or test split of the Flickr30K multimodal dataset for text-generation training
